What this is. A personal prototype: a Tableau dashboard embedded with the Tableau Embedding API v3, with a filter-change listener feeding the current selection into a small insight engine — so the narrative, the alert and the Q&A follow whatever is filtered in Tableau. Conceptually inspired by Tableau Pulse, Tableau Agent and Agentforce; my own lightweight take, not those products. Privacy by design: fully synthetic data; no individual records shown; groups under 5 suppressed.
